text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 - policy-engine runtime exception impacting smart-routing -> high 5xxs and fallback churn in us-west. Auto-pager to @mike oncall. link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/1801200456

mike: saw the page, jumping in. any initial error logs?

sara: getting stacktrace from policy-engine: `panic: runtime error: invalid expression token '=>' at char 42` then a runtime unwind. repeating every 12s per host.

arthur: metrics - 5xx rate on routing proxy spiked 4x at 07:02 UTC, latency up 600ms median. region fallback loops observed between us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for some customers.

sylvia: looks like a newly pushed routing rule used the `=>` arrow in a policy expression; policy engine eval code doesn't accept that token. probably slipped in via config PR #5423 which was merged 07:00 UTC.

mike: can we isolate by disabling the policy? that's the fastest mitigation. which policy id?

arthur: policy id `smart-routing-prod-v3` (owner: infra-routing).

sara: i'm disabling it now. command: 
```
redwoodctl policy disable --id smart-routing-prod-v3 --reason "runtime expr panic causing fallbacks"
```

eng-sre: command returned: `OK disabled smart-routing-prod-v3 on 6 nodes`

mike: tracing after disable - 5xxs dropping, tail-latency improving. good so far. still seeing some TTL-cached fallbacks for a few minutes.

customer-success-bot: flagging active CS tickets for impacted customers: acct-6734, acct-9921, acct-4402. Notifying CS leads.

sara: follow-up: we need a temporary static routing rule to avoid any further fallback decisions until we fix the expression. I'll push a safe default route to `model:gpt-medium-2024-08` in us-west-2.

arthur: apply command: 
```
redwoodctl route upsert --name fallback-safe-180120 --region us-west-2 --model "gpt-medium-2024-08" --priority 1000
```

deploy-bot: config apply succeeded: fallback-safe-180120 created (applied to 4 proxies)

mike: verified requests now consistently hitting gpt-medium-2024-08 in us-west-2. error rate back to baseline. marking incident mitigated.

sara: root cause: invalid operator `=>` in policy expression introduced in PR #5423 (author: jlee). reproduction: `if client.tags.env == "prod" => route(region="us-west-2")` - policy parser treats `=>` as unknown token and panics. parser should have returned a parse error.

arthur: impact assessment: approx 17% of requests during 07:02-07:10 UTC experienced model mismatch (served smaller model) or 5xxs for affected customers. Estimated customer-facing latency degradation for 8 customers with strict routing SLAs.

sylvia: mitigation checklist: 1) disabled offending policy (done), 2) created safe static route (done), 3) open rollback + fix PR for policy parser and sanitize expressions, 4) notify CS and affected customers, 5) schedule postmortem and assign owners.

mike: i'll own the immediate postmortem and timeline. target draft in 24h. next oncall handoff at 08:00 UTC goes to @sara. i'll collate logs and attach to the incident.

eng-sre: note for handoff - keep `fallback-safe-180120` in place until parser fix + safe config validation is deployed to prod. also add a canary config to validate expressions on staging before allowing merge.

customer-success-bot: CS notified external customers for acct-6734 and acct-9921; acct-4402 opted for internal alert only.

sara: creating hotfix PR to add expression parse guard and unit test. will not merge until CI has expression-fuzz tests. PR link: https://internal.redwood/pull/5489

arthur: once fix merged, plan: 1) enable server-side validation in staging for 48h 2) re-enable `smart-routing-prod-v3` with a canary (5% traffic) 3) monitor errors for 1 hour 4) full rollout if no errors.

mike: adding postmortem owner: mike, code owner: sara, config owner: arthur. severity: P0.

sylvia: tagging follow-ups: ops-infra (add lint for policy DSL), devex (docs updates on allowed operators), platform (add validation gate in CI).

oncall-bot: scheduled handoff reminder to @sara at 08:00 UTC.

mike: thanks all. leaving detailed logs in the incident doc and handing off to @sara for next steps.

sara: acknowledged, taking post-incident lead.

mike: last note - please include the exact failing expression and the PR diff in the postmortem so we can prevent similar merge regressions.

arthur: copied failing snippet: 
```
- route if client.tags.env == "prod" => route(region="us-west-2")
+ (should be) if client.tags.env == "prod" then route(region="us-west-2")
```

sara: adding that to the draft. closing slack thread for incident 1801200456; updates will continue in the incident tracker.
